-- 1. 查看 SOGO JOYCE 的 UP920A-VC 庫存現況
SELECT si.shopName, si.sku, si.productName, si.quantity, si.reservedQuantity
FROM shopInventory si
WHERE si.shopName LIKE '%JOYCE%' AND si.sku = 'UP920A-VC';
